title: React Is Dead? Next.js Took Over (Here's Proof)
description: Bhai, seedha baat karta hoon — React ab ek library hai, framework nahi. Aur Next.js ne uski gaadi cheen li hai. Every serious React project today runs inside Next.js. The routing, the data fetching, the SSR, the deployment — Next.js owns all of it now. React is just the rendering engine underneath. So are you still calling yourself a "React developer" in 2025? That title needs an upgrade. In this video, we break down exactly how Next.js swallowed the React ecosystem, what it means for your career, and whether React is actually dying or just evolving into something unrecognisable. If you are building with React and ignoring Next.js, you are already behind. This is not hype — this is the market. Watch till the end. Subscribe to CodeOrCap → @codeorcap | Stop Guessing. Start Knowing.
